current_main.note: M273 remains promoted main; M274 remains development-only on its active branch.

m274.agent_full_vax_green_evidence: Full OVMS Agent AGENT/BUILD/regression suite passed status 1 with the real nested-directory M234 regression; live nested Git acceptance also passed.
m274.phase1_evidence: Initial AGENT/WRITE scaffold from empty root failed without creating files (#54); immediate AGENT/BUILD failed due missing BUILD.COM; AGENT/REPAIR/PLAN again reproduced #53. Recovery used AGENT/CREATE for STORAGE.H, STORAGE.C, MAIN.C, BUILD.COM. First build succeeded with one DEC C informational time_t diagnostic; bounded AGENT/WRITE changed only tt < 0 to tt == (time_t)-1; clean target AGENT/BUILD passed status 1. Runtime smoke test passed add/list/show. Runtime/build/transcript artifacts were removed. Commit 98ae1f5 contains exactly the four target files and was pushed through AGENT/GITHUB/PUSH; GitHub compare shows one commit ahead, zero behind, exactly those four files.
m274.transport_workaround: OVMS_AGENT_NOSTREAM=1 remains in use because interactive SSE tool-call AGENT/WRITE previously hung; do not treat streaming tool-call mode as fixed.

phase_plan.phase2: Grow naturally to roughly 10-15 files with a config diff engine and first-pass rule engine. Then genuinely run MODULE/GRAPH, CLUSTER, and CYCLE. Do not intentionally design cycles away or manufacture them; if a real cycle exists, fix it through refactor commands rather than hand edits.
phase_plan.phase3: Perform genuine risk-scoring refactor in exact order: EXTRACT/FUNCTION, RENAME, MOVE/FUNCTION.
phase_plan.phase4: Meaningful change through branch + PR using AGENT/GITHUB/PR and normal review/merge.
phase_plan.phase5: At a natural boundary switch PROVIDER to a genuinely different backend and record behavioral differences.
phase_plan.phase6: Final reporting/query layer across more than one sitting using AGENT/SESSION/FORK and resume.
phase_plan.phase7: Write DOC/M274_RECONCILIATION.MD focused on OVMS Agent command coverage, failures, surprises, and unresolved gaps.

50.title: nested project Git-context capture fails on OpenVMS

51.summary: Composed AGENT context can exceed downstream request-builder 8KB limit with real Git diff.

52.summary: AGENT/TOOL/RUN PATCH corrupted && operators in one replacement path; native PATCH avoided the corruption.

53.summary: AGENT/BUILD does not persist diagnostics required by AGENT/REPAIR/PLAN; reproduced on compiler failure, regression failure, and missing BUILD.COM failure.

54.title: AGENT/WRITE cannot scaffold new project files from empty root
54.summary: AGENT/WRITE selected replace/patch operations against nonexistent files and finally printed source for manual saving. Phase 1 recovered via shipped AGENT/CREATE, so #54 remains open as an underlying write-loop defect.

observations: Nested Git context defect #50 was found before any target source generation and fixed through OVMS Agent self-hosting.
Interactive SSE tool-call mode hung; NOSTREAM progressed, leaving streaming tool-call coverage unresolved.
AGENT/WRITE can exhaust turns then falsely summarize unmade changes; transactional rollback also correctly removed incomplete writes.
Human approval caught incomplete and incorrect self-repair proposals.
Real nested M234 regression disproved an initially green but incomplete #50 fix and drove the OpenVMS full-filespec correction.
AGENT/WRITE cannot create an empty-project scaffold (#54), but AGENT/CREATE successfully created one guarded file per run.
AGENT/REPAIR/PLAN failed after the Phase 1 missing-BUILD.COM failure, third distinct #53 reproduction.
Generated Phase 1 code built on first recovery attempt except for one informational time_t comparison diagnostic; one bounded AGENT/WRITE fixed it and clean build passed.
Runtime smoke test passed add/list/show; OpenVMS DCL lowercased unquoted argv text but lookup remained consistent.
VAX Git canonicalized target paths to lowercase and reported all four new target files as mode 100755, including .c/.h; record as platform behavior and do not normalize unless it causes a real issue.
OVMS Agent created ovms_agent_transcript.dat in the target root; it was explicitly removed before staging.

standing_rules: At a new chat start read RULES.md from main and CHAT_SESSION_STATE.json from chat-session-state, then verify live GitHub main, active branch, and issue state.
Omit literal OVMS-AGENT> from lines intended to paste into OVMS Agent.
GitHub is the development control plane/source of truth; VAX/OpenVMS is authoritative for DEC C/VAX, RMS, DCL, runtime, and generated/uncommitted acceptance.
For M274 target implementation and OVMS Agent self-repair, do not substitute manual/GitHub source edits for the requested OVMS Agent flows. GitHub control-plane issue/state logging is allowed.
Use GITAUTH as the standing prompt-free raw Git network path on VAX/OpenVMS.
Do not use credential.helper=store, global credential.helper, or askpass as standing authentication solutions.
Never mark an untested GitHub head as a full VAX-green agent head.
Keep main, chat-session-state, active milestone branch, and only the two most recently completed milestone development branches; permanently tag milestones before pruning older completed branches.
next_work: Phase 1 is complete at remote head 98ae1f531e4ee7f98cb0f6ed57af2edb141c3e40.
Begin Phase 2 from the target root with OVMS Agent, naturally add a config diff engine and first-pass rule engine until the target has roughly 10-15 files.
Do not pre-design module boundaries merely to avoid cycles; once file growth is real, run MODULE/GRAPH, CLUSTER, and CYCLE genuinely and react to the observed graph.
If a real cycle is found, fix it using OVMS Agent refactor commands, not manual source editing.
Do not repair #51/#52/#53/#54 unless one blocks the next required M274 action; preserve unresolved defects as reconciliation evidence.
Log surprising OVMS Agent behavior on issue #49 as it occurs.
